Familiarity with service mesh (Istio) and edge/WAF tooling (Cloudflare). Familiarity with data infrastructure (Airflow, Databricks) and messaging/streaming systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, DynamoDB, MongoDB). Knowledge of network security, vulnerability management, and incident response best practices. Experience with Rollbar or centralized logging pipelines.
